facts.business: Kirloskar Brothers Limited is a pump manufacturing company focused on water, power, and irrigation sectors, with a strategic shift towards services, value-added products, and international operations.

guidance_or_targets.statement: We expect growth in EBITDA and profitability, driven by a stronger order book, higher share of engineered and made-to-order products, easing commodity pressures and sustained contribution from services.

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Key audit matter: Accounting treatment for customer contracts where performance obligations are satisfied over time (revenue recognition under IND AS 115 using percentage completion method)

key_risks: Revenue recognition complexities in long-term contracts using percentage completion method
Estimation uncertainties in project costs and completion stages
Working capital management in project-based business
